authority: read-only REQ/CLOSE on explicit saved WSS relays; no credentials, cookies, AUTH, EVENT, signer or decryption capability
lifecycle: slot/generation plus native program epoch; nonwrapping sequence, retained delivery until acknowledged, overflow closes/incomplete; reset retires every owner
clock: clock uses an owned slot/generation and sequence 0 with empty request payload, without opening a socket; kind clock has sequence 0 and exact nonnegative integer Unix seconds <= 9007199254740991 as decimal payload; reset completes with an empty service body
